covers: raylib's lighting example's setup (rlights.h, lighting.vs and lighting.fs, compiled ahead of time): a plane and a cube lit by point and directional lights, a light turned off; greenman lit and posed twice in a frame (skinned on the CPU, as raylib skins it), and lit by a program's own vertex stage over <helix/raylib/shaders/skinning.glsl> (skinned on the GPU, raylib's CPU skinning its oracle)
